name: mimo-jp-next
description: Counts of which typed unit follows which in Japanese, made by scripts/mimo_jp_next.py from the texts below; packed into mimo_jp_next.bin at build time. A clause with a term of Resources/Lexicon/blocked-terms.txt [ja] is not counted.
license: The counts are the project's own work; the texts they were counted in are CC-BY-2.0-FR (Tatoeba), CC0-1.0 (Common Voice) and written for this project. Words were split with the Mozc dictionary and connection costs (BSD-3-Clause, the revision pinned in scripts/mimo_jp_pipeline.py); no Mozc data is copied into the counts.
attribution: Tatoeba (https://tatoeba.org) and its contributors; Mozilla Common Voice sentence-collector contributors; Mozc (Google Inc.) for the dictionary used to split words.
